title: The Car Insurance Deductible Math Nobody Explains #Shorts
text:
Raising your collision and comprehensive deductible usually lowers your premium. Divide the extra out-of-pocket risk by the yearly savings to find how many claim-free years it takes to come out ahead, and keep that amount in savings.

Follow for the next one: what renters insurance actually covers.

General info only. Coverage and prices vary by state and insurer.
